newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- India's new prime minister says his government will pay for the travel to Saudi Arabia of relatives of Indian pilgrims killed or injured in a huge fire near Mecca.
- Four Sudanese pilgrims confirmed dead in haj fire. Some 343 pilgrims were killed and around 1,500 injured when fire gutted their tents near Mecca.
- Traffic at King Khalid international airport in Riyadh was brought to a halt for three hours on Monday due to bad weather.
- Saudi Arabia's Shura (consultative) council chairman urges the private sector to invest in tourism in Saudi Arabia.
- Britain is investing $3 billion in Saudi Arabia, British ambassador says.
